newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian singer Renato Russo dies from illness.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian singer Renato Russo dies from illness.

text.p: One of Brazil's most popular rock musicians, Renato Manfredini Jr., known best by his stage name Renato Russo, died on Friday from a pulmonary infection, his recording company said.

Russo, 36, who sang with rock band Legiao Urbana (Urban Legion), was also one of Brazil's most prodigious songwriters. Since its formation in the early 1980s, the band sold more than five million copies of its records, an EMI Music Ltd spokesman said.

Russo was an unflagging critic of what he considered the hypocrisy of conservative Brazilian society, which he shocked when he declared his homosexuality. No further details were available on his illness.
